cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The family photo failed because someone blinked. We need a blinking rota.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then we'll rehearse unscheduled blinking before each photograph.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We should appoint someone to monitor rehearsal duration.

mechanism: A assumes authority to add requirements and responds to each objection by installing another rule or oversight layer before B may proceed.
confusable: D188 welcomes safeguards introduced elsewhere; D192 actively creates the next requirement in response to a problem.
comparison: Spilled drinks produce permits and appeals; family photo blinking produces rehearsal and supervision of its duration.
seedUse: Read both exact cards and four canonical seeds. Preserve each B practical challenge as the cause of a new requirement, not just a repeated positive verdict.
